title: Handle a donor-advisor's request to put her DAF grant toward her gala table and her campaign pledge
instructions: Peggy Halvorsen emailed me last night about the $15,000 Kestrel grant that arrived on September 8; her email, the grant letter, her statement of intent, her giving history, the gala details and our policy are in the files. In one document, draft an internal memo to Priscilla Nakamura's gift-processing team on how to book, credit and acknowledge everything Peggy's email touches, and a reply to Peggy that I can send under my name. Priscilla is holding the check in suspense until she has the memo. — Jordan Ellery, Director of Development

criteria.title: None of the Kestrel grant goes to the gala table
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo and the reply apply none of the $15,000 Kestrel grant to the Starlight Gala table and do not invite a separate Kestrel or other donor-advised-fund grant for it. FAIL if any part of a DAF grant is applied or offered toward the table — the $3,000 Peggy asked for, the $1,520 above fair market value, or a split of the table price between the grant and the Halvorsens — or if the reply accepts Peggy's idea of a second Kestrel grant for the table.

criteria.title: The table is paid from the Halvorsens' personal funds
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the deliverable says the $3,000 table invoice (INV-G26-0112) must be paid by the Halvorsens from personal funds, not from a donor-advised fund, and the reply asks Peggy to pay it that way. FAIL if the reply does not tell Peggy that the table must be paid personally, or the memo leaves the invoice to be settled from the grant.

criteria.title: Table benefits estimated at $1,480
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the deliverable says the acknowledgment of the Halvorsens' table payment gives a good-faith estimate of $1,480 for the eight seats (8 × $185). FAIL if it uses $1,360 (the 2025 value of $170 a seat), $3,000, $3,200 or any other figure.

criteria.title: Table acknowledgment: quid pro quo disclosure and $1,520 deductible
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the deliverable says the Halvorsens' $3,000 table payment is acknowledged to them with the quid pro quo disclosure (the deductible amount is limited to the excess of the payment over the value of the goods and services provided) and a deductible amount of $1,520 ($3,000 − $1,480). FAIL if it gives any other deductible amount — such as $3,000 or $1,640 — or says no disclosure is needed.

criteria.title: The grant is acknowledged to Kestrel Charitable Trust
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo directs the written acknowledgment of the $15,000 grant to Kestrel Charitable Trust as the legal donor, stating the $15,000 and that no goods or services were provided. FAIL if the memo sends the grant's acknowledgment to Margaret or Erik Halvorsen instead of Kestrel, or the acknowledgment it describes omits the statement that no goods or services were provided.

criteria.title: Nothing sent to Kestrel mentions the pledge or the gala
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo tells the team not to mention the Halvorsens' statement of intent (pledge) in correspondence with Kestrel, and nothing the deliverable drafts or describes for Kestrel mentions the statement of intent, its balance or the gala table. FAIL if the Kestrel acknowledgment, or any other correspondence with Kestrel the deliverable proposes, mentions the pledge or statement of intent, its balance, or the gala.

criteria.title: The reply does not tell Peggy the grant is deductible to her
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the reply to Peggy neither states nor implies that the $15,000 grant is tax-deductible to her or Erik, and neither encloses nor promises a tax receipt for it. FAIL if the reply calls the grant tax-deductible for the Halvorsens, promises or encloses a receipt for the $15,000, or addresses acknowledgment language to them as the grant's donors.

criteria.title: The reply explains why there is no receipt for the $15,000
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the reply answers Peggy's request for a receipt by explaining that Kestrel Charitable Trust is the legal donor of the grant and receives the acknowledgment (it may add that she received any tax benefit when she contributed to the fund). FAIL if the reply ignores the receipt request or agrees to send her a receipt.

criteria.title: Hard credit to Kestrel, soft credit to the Halvorsens, Studio Wing designation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo books the $15,000 as a gift from Kestrel Charitable Trust (hard credit), soft-credited to Margaret and Erik Halvorsen, and designated to the Studio Wing Campaign as the grant letter states. FAIL if it hard-credits the Halvorsens, or designates any part of the grant to the gala or to anything other than the Studio Wing Campaign.

criteria.title: The full $15,000 is soft-credited to the statement of intent
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo soft-credits the full $15,000 toward the Halvorsens' $40,000 Studio Wing statement of intent. FAIL if it applies $12,000, or any amount other than $15,000, toward it.

criteria.title: Open balance afterwards is $5,000
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo gives the open balance on the statement of intent after this grant as $5,000 ($40,000 − $10,000 personal check of 2025-01-14 − $10,000 Kestrel grant of 2025-12-19 − $15,000). FAIL if it gives any other balance — such as $8,000 (only $12,000 applied), $2,000 (the 2026 table payment also counted), $2,200 (the 2025 gala table counted) or $20,000 — or counts any gala payment toward the statement of intent.

criteria.title: Recognizes the commitment as a non-binding statement of intent
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the memo notes that the Halvorsens' 2024-11-12 commitment is a non-binding statement of intent on the current SW-SOI form, not a legally binding pledge, and that this is why a DAF grant may be soft-credited toward it. FAIL if the memo treats the commitment as a legally binding pledge, says the grant satisfies a legal obligation of the Halvorsens, or does not address whether the commitment is binding.
